about: Firmus L4 v3 (llama31_8b, nemo_l4_nvfp4_v3): how build_all.py builds every auto_kernel extension from ./csrc and lays out the Python (Triton) kernels and data files under ${FIRMUS_AK_PREFIX}. Each extension is built exactly as its validated module was: torch.utils.cpp_extension.load(name, sources, extra_include_paths, extra_cflags, extra_cuda_cflags, extra_ldflags, with_cuda) with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST set to 'arch', the sources staged flat in one directory (as in the dev directory the validated build used; 'include_src_dir' = the validated call passed that directory as extra_include_paths). 'te_include' paths are relative to TE_SRC (/workspace/transformerengine, the TE 5b28d7aa source tree of section 2). In extra_ldflags, {TE_LIB} = the installed transformer_engine package directory and {TE_LIBNAME} = the one libtransformer_engine*.so in it. 'evidence' names the dev script (auto_kernel_llama31_8b, local/l8b/...) whose load() call and environment the flags reproduce; flags_status 'exact' = copied from that call and its run script, 'inferred' = not traced to the build of the deployed binary.
